text.arabic_uthmani: وَلِكُلٍّۢ دَرَجَٰتٌۭ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟ ۖ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening connector that resumes the prior verdict and leads into a universal accounting frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later connectors in the same ayah

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens in connective mode: it does not detach 46:19 from 46:18, but carries the loss verdict into a wider rule of ranked recompense. Its sound also returns at words 7 and 11, so the ayah is heard as three joined movements: principle, purpose, and guarantee.

topics.headline: opening connector widens the prior verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is connected to 46:18 while widening that verdict into a general accounting principle.
topics.reason: The particle is a conjunction in the QAC row, while the boundary rows coherently preserve a resumptive force after 46:18; local evidence supports connected widening rather than an isolated maxim.

topics.headline: three connectors segment the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated connector dividing the ayah into principle, purpose, and guarantee.
topics.reason: The clause evidence identifies a nominal opening, a purpose clause, and a final circumstantial clause, matching the three connector rows.

words.gloss_range: assignment or specification in a fronted recipient frame, not purpose

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later purpose lām before the fulfillment verb
distributed recipient governed by this preposition

words.prose: The first {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) assigns the coming ranks to {{ar:كُلٍّۢ}} ({{tr:kullin}}) as allotted, not inherent. Because this phrase is fronted, the sentence starts from recipient distribution; only the later {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) at word 8 turns into purpose.

topics.headline: assignment lām frames allocated ranks
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ranks are allotted for each recipient rather than presented as an inherent status.
topics.reason: The QAC and attachment evidence show this preposition governing the genitive recipient phrase before the rank noun.

topics.headline: paired lām particles diverge in function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same particle sound first assigns ranks and later introduces purpose.
topics.reason: Word 2 governs the noun in the fronted phrase, while word 8 introduces the purposive subjunctive verb clause.

words.gloss_range: open distributive each one, governed by assignment lām and extending over the contrasted groups
words.root_gloss_range: root range of totality, collectivity, and exhaustive coverage; here narrowed to distributive universal scope

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: ranked levels assigned to each
closing non-wronging guarantee for the distributed set

words.prose: {{ar:كُلٍّۢ}} ({{tr:kullin}}) is singular in form but open in scope: the tanwīn leaves it as each one, not each member of a named class. The following plural forms unfold that singular entry point into all recipients, and the near-repeated formula with {{ar:دَرَجَٰتٌۭ}} ({{tr:darajātun}}) recalls ranked recompense language such as 6:132. That total coverage is graded and later sealed by the non-wronging guarantee, not left as flat totality. Within the surah, the same totality pressure later turns toward comprehensive destruction (46:25) and divine capability (46:33), so here it is specifically total coverage under accounting.

topics.headline: open distributive scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase means each one without naming a class, so both prior contrasted groups remain inside the accounting frame.
topics.reason: The tanwīn and lack of an annexed complement keep the quantifier open, and attachment evidence says it reaches across the two contrasted groups in 46:13-18.

topics.headline: singular quantifier routes into plural reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how one singular quantifier unfolds into plural verbs and pronouns across the ayah.
topics.reason: The local plural verb and pronoun chain is licensed by semantic plurality rather than by the bare singular shape.

topics.headline: total coverage joins graded justice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that total coverage is not flat: it is expressed through graded recompense and sealed by non-wronging.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows point to recurring pairings of totality with ranks, fulfillment, and non-wronging; nothing in local grammar blocks that formulaic pressure.

topics.headline: same-surah totality turns in opposite directions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same surah uses totality for both ranked accounting here and comprehensive destruction later.
topics.reason: The same-surah references preserve a real scope contrast: totality in 46:19 distributes recompense, while totality in 46:25 and 46:33 marks other comprehensive claims.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural ranked levels assigned to each, sourced from deeds and open in number
words.root_gloss_range: root range of stepping, gradual movement, and rank; here the noun selects established graded levels

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: source phrase tying ranks to deeds

words.prose: {{ar:دَرَجَٰتٌۭ}} ({{tr:darajātun}}) is the delayed nominative subject after the recipient frame, so the first beat presents a standing architecture of ranks. Its plural form and stepwise root pressure make the outcome graduated rather than binary, and {{ar:مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:mimmā ʿamilū}}) makes those levels proportional to deeds. The ranked-deeds wording also reprises the recompense formula in 6:132. Contrast rows about hidden gradual drawing or the descending-depth term in 4:145 help sharpen the local choice: this word names established ranked levels, not a concealed process or descending-depth term.

topics.headline: delayed subject in a standing assignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause states a standing rank arrangement before any verb of payment appears.
topics.reason: The local clause is nominal, with the fronted recipient phrase followed by the nominative rank noun as delayed subject.

topics.headline: plural ranks make recompense graduated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recompense is a spectrum of levels from deeds, not a flat binary label.
topics.reason: The plural rank noun and the source phrase from what they did select graduated recompense.

topics.headline: rank imagery contrasted with other root paths
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word carries stepwise rank pressure while local grammar keeps it as established levels, not hidden gradual drawing.
topics.reason: Rows about gradual drawing and descending depths are useful as contrast, but the local noun selects transparent ranked levels tied to deeds; the near-verbatim formula with 6:132 remains directly relevant.

words.gloss_range: compound from and what/that which, linking ranks to deeds as source, cause, and measure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: rank noun governed by the source relation
deed verb completed by the compound phrase

words.prose: {{ar:مِّمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) is the hinge between ranks and deeds. It lets the levels arise from, because of, and in measure with what was done, while the mā element can focus either the doing itself or the deed-product.

topics.headline: source hinge between ranks and deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ranks are tethered to deeds as source, cause, and measure rather than floating free.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the compound as the source complement of the rank noun and the relative/object content of the deed verb.

topics.headline: mā keeps action and product in view
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the slight double focus between their doing as process and what they did as result.
topics.reason: Both maṣdariyya and mawṣūla-style readings remain compatible with the local relative/source phrase.

words.gloss_range: completed purposeful deeds, left open in content but made the basis for ranked recompense
words.root_gloss_range: root range of doing, working, producing, and accountable deeds; here selected as completed purposeful action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: distributed set supplying the plural actors
same-root noun record later rendered back

words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) turns the open each into plural actors and treats their action as completed input for accounting. The object-content is not narrowed to one deed class; it is whatever they did, and the root pressure makes this purposeful work with consequence rather than bare action. The same root then returns as {{ar:أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ}} ({{tr:aʿmālahum}}), so performed work becomes the owned record that full settlement will address.

topics.headline: plural verb routes the open each into actors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the singular each becoming a plural field of doers through verbal agreement.
topics.reason: The verb is third masculine plural and points back to the open distributed set by meaning.

topics.headline: completed deeds remain unrestricted in content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deeds are treated as completed accounting inputs without limiting the deed class.
topics.reason: The perfect verb and broad object content in the preceding compound phrase support completed, open-ended action.

topics.headline: purposeful work generates rank
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ranked outcome is tied to purposeful work with consequence, not bare motion or a named single act.
topics.reason: The local source phrase binds the deed verb to ranks, and the lexical rows keep accountable work pressure coherent.

topics.headline: doing becomes settleable record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from performed action to the owned deed-record that will be fully rendered.
topics.reason: The same root reappears as the noun object at word 10 and the sequence moves from human action to the purpose clause of settlement.

topics.headline: misassigned voice contrast without local payoff
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The row belongs to the later non-wronging verb contrast and does not add a separate payoff for the local deed verb.
topics.reason: The row concerns the wronging root and the final passive clause, not the local deed verb, and adds no distinct reader-facing payoff for word 6.

words.gloss_range: connector before a purpose clause, pivoting from rank-source to fulfillment rationale

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: purpose sequence introduced after this connector

words.prose: The middle {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins a completed rank statement to the dependent purpose clause. It is the pivot from the deed-source phrase to {{ar:لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ}} ({{tr:li-yuwaffiyahum}}), and as the second of three connectors it holds the ayah's central turn.

topics.headline: middle connector pivots to purpose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivoting from what deeds produce to why the rank system completes them.
topics.reason: The connector precedes the purpose lām clause, linking a complete rank statement to its rationale.

topics.headline: middle wāw holds the three-part chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the middle connector as the central member of the ayah's principle-purpose-guarantee chain.
topics.reason: The three local connector positions correspond to the three local clause movements.

words.gloss_range: purpose or result lām before the fulfillment verb, not the earlier assignment lām

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier assignment lām
subjunctive fulfillment verb governed by this particle

words.prose: The second {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) makes {{ar:يُوَفِّيَهُمْ}} ({{tr:yuwaffiyahum}}) a subjunctive purpose or result clause. It echoes the first {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) in sound, but its job is different: word 2 assigns ranks to each, while word 8 subordinates the verb that explains the rank system's rationale.

topics.headline: purpose lām governs fulfillment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that full recompense is grammatically marked as the purpose or outcome of the rank arrangement.
topics.reason: The local evidence marks this as lām al-taʿlīl governing the subjunctive fulfillment verb.

topics.headline: same lām sound, different job
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural echo between the first assignment lām and this purpose lām without confusing their functions.
topics.reason: Word 2 governs a noun in the recipient frame, while this word governs the following verb as a purpose clause.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive purpose verb of full rendering, with recipients attached and deeds supplied as the second object
words.root_gloss_range: root range of fulfillment, full payment, completion, faithfulness, and taking fully; here narrowed to complete recompense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second object, the deeds fully rendered
non-wronging guarantee protecting the settlement

words.prose: {{ar:يُوَفِّيَهُمْ}} ({{tr:yuwaffiyahum}}) is governed by the purpose particle, making full rendering the rationale for the ranked system. Its attached recipient suffix marks the recipients, and {{ar:أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ}} ({{tr:aʿmālahum}}) supplies what is rendered: their deeds return to them as complete settlement. The doubled fāʾ of the Form II shape and the repeated recipient suffix make the completion pressure audible. Variant voicings of the verb expose agency pressure, but the local surface keeps the fulfiller implicit while the recompense frame makes that agency understood; the verb also answers 46:18's loss verdict and resumes the same-surah recompense movement from 46:14.

topics.headline: subjunctive fulfillment as middle beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fulfillment verb is not free-floating; it is the purpose toward which the first rank statement points.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect subjunctive after the purpose lām and forms the central verbal beat.

topics.headline: full settlement returns deeds to recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices full settlement as an exact return of owned deeds to their recipients, while broader root overtones stay subordinate to recompense.
topics.reason: The local double-object frame selects full recompense of deeds to recipients; broader root associations such as taking fully add finality pressure but do not replace the local payment sense.

topics.headline: agency is present but surface-distributed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine agency as grammatically present through the verb while variant readings expose different voicings of that agency.
topics.reason: The local surface has an implicit third masculine singular subject; accepted person variants are useful as contrast, not replacements for the canonical local form.

topics.headline: full settlement answers the surrounding recompense frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this verb as the accounting answer to the prior loss verdict and same-surah recompense language.
topics.reason: The rows point to formulaic settlement with deeds and to same-surah movement from recompense language in 46:14 into explicit full rendering here.

topics.headline: sound thickens recipient-linked settlement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the intensified form and repeated recipient suffix helping bind full payment, deeds, and protected subjects.
topics.reason: The shaddah and recurring suffix are surface features that support the same full-settlement payoff without changing the parse.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural deed-record, the direct object rendered in full
words.root_gloss_range: root range of doing, work, deeds, and produced results; here selected as owned accumulated deeds

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: same-root verb whose action becomes the noun record
fulfillment verb taking this as object

words.prose: {{ar:أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ}} ({{tr:aʿmālahum}}) names the deeds as an owned plural record. It completes {{ar:يُوَفِّيَهُمْ}} ({{tr:yuwaffiyahum}}) by saying what full rendering consists of, and it echoes {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}): action has become an account. The repeated recipient suffix sound keeps recipient, deed-owner, and final protected subject tied together, so the deed-record is carried into the guarantee against distortion or diminution.

topics.headline: owned deeds are the object of fulfillment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is rendered is their own deeds, not a substitute or someone else's account.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the explicit second object of the fulfillment verb, with a possessive suffix attaching deeds to their owners.

topics.headline: plural deeds form an accountable record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices many acts gathered into a possessed record or portfolio for settlement.
topics.reason: The broken plural plus suffix makes the object both multiple and personally assigned.

topics.headline: performed action crystallizes into returned account
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verb-to-noun shift: what they did becomes the owned account that is fully paid back.
topics.reason: The same root appears first as the deed verb and then as the noun object of full rendering.

topics.headline: deed object moves into non-wronging guarantee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the deed-record carried from payment into the final guarantee against distortion or diminution.
topics.reason: The local sequence places the owned deed object before the final circumstantial non-wronging clause, and the recurring suffix links recipient, owner, and protected subject.

words.gloss_range: final connector, most strongly circumstantial, introducing attached protection

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: closing guarantee clause

words.prose: The final {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the guarantee clause and binds it to the payment scene. The circumstantial reading is strongest: full rendering happens with {{ar:هُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:hum lā yuẓlamūna}}) as its accompanying state, not as an afterthought. As the third connector, it completes the principle-purpose-guarantee architecture.

topics.headline: final connector attaches the guarantee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that non-wronging accompanies the full recompense scene rather than arriving as a detached moral statement.
topics.reason: The evidence strongly licenses a circumstantial relation after the fulfillment clause; simple coordination remains a weaker connected reading.

topics.headline: third connector completes the architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing guarantee as the third step in the ayah's connector chain.
topics.reason: The final connector introduces the last local clause after the opening principle and middle purpose movements.

words.gloss_range: detached plural pronoun foregrounding the protected recipients in the final circumstantial clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening distributed antecedent
passive verb that already carries plural agreement

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) is not needed merely to show plural agreement, because {{ar:يُظْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yuẓlamūna}}) already does that. Its detached placement re-establishes the recipients at the front of the guarantee. Because it opens the circumstantial nominal clause, the protection reads as an accompanying state of recompense. It resumes the distributed reach of {{ar:كُلٍّۢ}} ({{tr:kullin}}), so the close protects the accounted set rather than naming a new group.

topics.headline: detached pronoun foregrounds protected recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recipients placed explicitly before the negated passive rather than left only inside the verb ending.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the detached pronoun as the explicit subject before the passive verb.

topics.headline: pronoun opens a nominal circumstantial clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final guarantee as a state attached to recompense, not only a separate verbal assertion.
topics.reason: The pronoun begins the circumstantial nominal clause after the final connector.

topics.headline: pronoun resumes the distributed set
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun carries the opening each into the close, while the local discourse keeps both prior groups in view.
topics.reason: A restricted prior-group reading is possible in isolation, but attachment evidence supports distributive reference across the contrasted groups/persons receiving recompense.

words.gloss_range: negation particle that denies passive wronging as a standing guarantee

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: passive verb negated by this particle

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) fixes the polarity of the close: wronging is denied, not merely reduced, so no diminution or misplacement is allowed in the account. With the imperfect passive it gives the guarantee standing force, and the non-wronging phrase echoes recompense seals such as 2:281, 3:25, and 3:161. After the loss verdict in 46:18, this negation makes the justice frame explicit.

topics.headline: negation scopes over passive wronging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that justice is stated as an explicit ongoing denial of wronging, diminution, or misplacement.
topics.reason: The negator directly scopes over the imperfect passive, preserving absence of wronging without adding an explicit agent.

topics.headline: non-wronging formula begins with negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final phrase as a familiar recompense seal, not just an ordinary negative clause.
topics.reason: The exact formula recurs in recompense closures, and the concrete references in the rows support formulaic pressure.

topics.headline: negated injustice answers affirmed loss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 46:19 balancing the affirmed loss of 46:18 with an explicit denial of injustice.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives a concrete relation between the prior verdict and the final negated guarantee.

words.gloss_range: imperfect passive denial of being wronged, diminished, misplaced, or deprived
words.root_gloss_range: root range of wronging, injustice, putting out of place, diminution, and darkness; here narrowed to passive non-wronging with loss and obscuration pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negator governing the passive verb
deed-record protected by the guarantee

words.prose: {{ar:يُظْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yuẓlamūna}}) is the final word and the passive seal of the ayah. It suppresses any wronging agent and foregrounds the protected recipients: no misplacement, diminution, or deprivation reaches the rendered account. Its imperfect plural ending keeps the guarantee open over the whole distributed set, not a single completed incident. The root's darkness pressure can support the sense of no obscuring, but the Form I passive keeps injustice and deprivation primary; the exact non-wronging formula recurs in recompense settings such as 2:281, 3:25, 3:161, 4:77, and 11:15. It also reverses earlier wrongdoer language in 46:12, moving from active wrongdoers to protected recipients.

topics.headline: passive guarantee suppresses the wronging agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recipients protected from wronging without the clause naming any possible wronging agent.
topics.reason: The verb is Form I imperfect passive; attachment evidence marks the agent as unexpressed and the pronoun as explicit subject.

topics.headline: plural imperfect applies the guarantee to the distributed set
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the guarantee extending over the whole distributed plurality rather than a single completed incident.
topics.reason: The imperfect passive and plural ending agree with the distributed recipients and preserve ongoing or future-oriented force under negation.

topics.headline: wronging, diminution, and obscuring are narrowed by Form I passive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word denies injustice as misplacement or diminution, while darkness pressure remains image-support rather than the selected verb sense.
topics.reason: The local Form I passive selects being wronged or deprived; darkness-related branches can support obscuration imagery but a Form IV darkening reading is not locally selected.

topics.headline: final seal joins formula, deed justice, and surah reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the last word as a formal seal that reverses earlier wrongdoer language into protected reception.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete formula references and same-surah role reversal; the final-position evidence makes the guarantee structural as well as lexical.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The distributive opening, differentiated degrees, causal relation to deeds, full delivery, and passive denial of wrong form one settlement construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Every accountable subject is assigned a differentiated outcome corresponding to intentional action; complete delivery prevents both short payment and detention of a due right.

activation_trace.role: The all-enclosing sense makes the opening distributive over every accountable subject.
Taking something degree by degree supplies calibrated differentiation rather than one undivided result.
Intentional action supplies the conduct to which the differentiated result corresponds.
Completion without deficiency makes settlement exhaustive rather than approximate.
Withholding or confining a right defines the failure explicitly excluded from settlement.

changed_reading.after: Each person receives a calibrated, deed-corresponding settlement whose defining safeguard is complete delivery without withheld right.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The degrees are linked directly to what subjects repeatedly do, while completion gives the sequence an endpoint.
baseline_models.mechanism: Degrees can be traversed stages rather than static shelves: intended acts move a subject step by step, and full settlement brings that enacted course to its meeting point.

activation_trace.role: Walking and proceeding on a path turns degrees into positions along an enacted course.
Stepwise taking supplies the transition rule from one stage to the next.
Purposive acts function as the motions that generate the trajectory.
Arrival at an appointment gives the deed-made path a terminal encounter rather than merely a score.

changed_reading.before: Degrees are fixed vertical ranks assigned after action.
changed_reading.after: Degrees are also successive states made traversable by action, with settlement completing the path those actions enacted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled work root, differentiated grades, full payment, and denial of withheld rights permit an administrative labor model.
baseline_models.mechanism: Each subject can be heard as a commissioned worker with graded responsibility; deeds are discharged work, and complete fulfillment resembles payment that cannot be docked or detained.

activation_trace.role: Holding and administering an assigned office makes action answerable as discharged responsibility.
The wage of work turns the returned works into an exploratory remuneration model.
Full payment of a right supplies the model's exact remuneration rule.
Non-withholding makes the closing clause an anti-deduction safeguard within the labor analogy.

changed_reading.before: Works are only moral items in a ledger.
changed_reading.after: Works may also be responsibilities performed under a commission, with differentiated grades and an undiminished due return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly displays manifest material being put under false labels, then names unjust agents. Against that pattern, the focus denial of wrong can govern classification as well as quantity: no person, deed, or outcome is placed in the wrong evaluative class.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing outside its proper place makes correct evaluative placement part of the focus safeguard.
Exact completion requires not only enough return but the right return under the right description.
Manifest disclosure supplies the clearly presented material that is nevertheless misclassified.
Diversion and deception supply the false category imposed on what had been manifest.
Fabricated falsehood supplies a second wrong label, making misdescription a repeated contextual action.
Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies a corrective procedure for false classification.
The agentive wrong-placement label contrasts with the focus passive: subjects may misplace evidence, but are not themselves misplaced in settlement.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from clear presentation to a deceptive label, then from an allegation of invention to testimony.
The same wrong root appears first as an agent label and later in the focus as a negated passive patient condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated label reversals, testimony, and the wrong-placement branch. I infer that final grading corrects taxonomic as well as quantitative error. A live alternative confines the focus denial to deprivation of due recompense.

changed_reading.before: They are not wronged because nothing is subtracted from the amount due.
changed_reading.after: They are also not wronged because neither their deeds nor their resulting degree is misnamed, misclassified, or put in an alien place.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rejected social argument treats arriving earlier as proof of greater good. This blocks a prestige reading of degrees: temporal or group precedence is not itself the grading rule; intentional action remains the stated differentiator.

activation_trace.role: Path movement permits relative positions, while leaving open what legitimately produces them.
Intentional action supplies the focus verse's explicit criterion in place of social arrival order.
Claimed superiority supplies the value that speakers incorrectly infer from their group's position.
Precedence and racing supply the mistaken proxy for goodness that the focus deed criterion displaces.
Failure of gentle direction to the true path marks the precedence argument as an unreliable grading rule.

structural_cues: The verse embeds a counterfactual social comparison: if it were good, others would not have preceded us to it.
The focus later replaces that comparison with a direct relation between each subject and what that subject did.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a social equation of precedence with value and then marks non-guidance. I infer that the focus degrees answer that false hierarchy with deed-relative differentiation. A live alternative is that the earlier statement exposes only polemic, without constraining the semantics of degrees.

changed_reading.before: Higher degree naturally tracks being earlier, socially dominant, or publicly ahead.
changed_reading.after: Degree is decoupled from prestige and chronological precedence; it corresponds to enacted responsibility for each subject.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered movement from hidden carrying through separation and repeated attainment to mature action gives the trajectory baseline a life-course mechanism. Degrees become thresholds at which new capacities and responsibilities are reached and exercised.

activation_trace.role: Stepwise progression supplies the focus anchor for successive developmental thresholds.
Intended conduct makes each attained stage answerable through what is done from it.
Hidden carrying and fruit supply the first, not-yet-visible phase of the staged process.
Separation of a child from mother or nursing supplies a definite transition between dependent stages.
Repeated arrival at an endpoint supplies explicit thresholds of maturity.
The mature request to perform intentional good action links reached capacity back to accountable work.

structural_cues: The verse gives a chronological chain of carrying, birth, separation, measured months, attained strength, attained age, gratitude, action, and descendants.
Repeated attainment language makes the stages explicit before the focus verse names degrees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a marked developmental sequence ending in chosen action. I infer that acts both become possible at attained stages and determine movement through accountable stages. A live alternative treats the life sequence as one example adjacent to, but not explanatory of, the focus degrees.

changed_reading.before: Degrees are only post-action ranks assigned at judgment.
changed_reading.after: Degrees can also be life-course thresholds: capacities mature stepwise, action issues from each threshold, and those actions shape the completed course.

context_deltas.mechanism: Acceptance of the best and passage beyond bad items interrupts a mechanical one-item-for-one-item ledger. Full fulfillment can apply after evaluative transformation: the settled account is complete without being a raw replay of every deed.

activation_trace.role: Intentional good and bad action supplies the account's heterogeneous input.
Completion without deficiency governs the final transformed settlement rather than requiring raw itemwise mirroring.
Reception with approval makes acceptance an evaluative operation, not mere recording.
The contrast of beauty with ugliness supplies the selection of the best portion.
Leaving blame behind and pardoning supplies subtraction by mercy rather than subtraction by injustice.
Badness and defect identify the material passed over instead of being mechanically reproduced.

structural_cues: One clause selects the best of what was done while the next passes beyond bad items.
The focus verse later retains both complete fulfillment and the denial of injustice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selective acceptance, pardon, and later complete fulfillment. I infer a two-stage account: mercy transforms the input, then justice completes the resulting settlement. A live alternative limits that transformation to the immediately described group while reading the focus as a more general unmodified rule.

changed_reading.before: Full fulfillment means every deed must return in a mechanically equivalent itemized result.
changed_reading.after: Full fulfillment can coexist with selective acceptance and pardon: completeness describes the final settlement, not an unmerciful replay of raw entries.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good things can be sent away through earlier enjoyment, while later recompense is presented as experienced or tasted. The focus fulfillment therefore spans temporal allocation and embodied realization, not only an abstract score at one instant.

activation_trace.role: Full completion supplies the total settlement across earlier consumption and later realization.
Stagewise movement allows portions of an outcome to be realized at different times.
Going away supplies the depletion of good portions during an earlier phase.
Enjoyed benefit supplies concrete realization rather than merely nominal possession.
Answering an act with its recompense explicitly joins prior conduct to the later phase.
Experiencing and undergoing a thing turns the eventual outcome into lived encounter.

structural_cues: The context contrasts worldly life with today, then later stages a direct presentation followed by tasting.
Earlier enjoyment and later recompense are grammatically tied to prior conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies goods already spent, enjoyed benefit, later recompense, and experienced tasting. I infer a temporally distributed settlement whose phases become embodied. A live alternative reads the scenes as separate rebukes rather than portions of one allocation model.

changed_reading.before: Degrees are an abstract final ranking added after life ends.
changed_reading.after: Settlement can expose what was already consumed, what remains to be answered, and how the resulting degree becomes an experienced state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Enabled faculties are listed, then declared ineffective because knowing denial governed them. This expands deeds from visible events to the employment, nonemployment, or misdirection of endowed capacity; degrees register stewardship of means as well as produced acts.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing to work turns endowed faculties into instruments whose use belongs to the deed profile.
Wrong placement supplies the possibility that a real capacity is directed to an alien function.
Enablement and capability supply the entrusted means available for action.
Understanding and compliance make hearing an actionable capacity rather than passive sensation.
Inner discernment makes sight a mode of responsible judgment.
The heart as internal ignition supplies motive and inward processing behind outward work.
Sufficiency and effectiveness supply the failed functional test of those capacities.
Denial despite knowledge supplies the governing misuse that renders equipped faculties ineffective.

structural_cues: The same hearing, sights, and hearts are first granted and then repeated as failing to avail anything.
The failure is linked to knowing denial, so possession and responsible operation are distinguished.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enablement, repeated faculties, failed efficacy, and denial with knowledge. I infer that accountable work includes how capacities were operated or left functionally idle. A live alternative counts only overt acts and treats the faculties as background causes rather than deed components.

changed_reading.before: What they did is a list of discrete outward events.
changed_reading.after: What they did includes a capacity-use profile: what hearing, discernment, and inward motive were enabled to do, refused to do, or made unable to accomplish.

context_deltas.mechanism: A tightly ordered chain moves a group into range, through hearing and attentive silence, to completion, return, and warning; the next verse names a straight extended path. Degrees become functional transitions in which reception enables transformed agency and transmission.

activation_trace.role: Proceeding along a route anchors the ordered contextual sequence back in the focus degrees.
Intentional action turns each transition from mere location into enacted response.
Conversion from one state to another supplies entry into the reception process.
Understanding and compliance make hearing the operative uptake stage.
Attentive silence supplies the disciplined condition that lets reception deepen.
Completion and coming to an end mark the boundary after which the next action begins.
One thing following another supplies the ordered handoff from listening to return and warning.
Gentle direction to truth supplies the destination and orientation of the transformed agency.
An extended route makes the sequence a continuous path rather than isolated moments.

structural_cues: The verbs form a strict temporal sequence: directed, heard, attended, completed, turned, and warned.
The following speech identifies guidance toward truth and an extended straight route.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered reception, completion, return, transmission, and path imagery. I infer causal arrows from attentive reception to changed agency and from changed agency to warning others. A live alternative treats the chain as narrative chronology without making it a model for the focus degrees.

changed_reading.before: Degrees are outcome bins reached only after deeds are finished.
changed_reading.after: Degrees can be transitions within action itself: being brought near, listening, attending, completing, turning, and transmitting form a deed-generated path of changed agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because folds, drawers, and containers are materially distant from the ordinary rank sense. It remains anchored in the focus degree and work roots and is activated by a fixed term, registry, and surviving trace. Downstream prose should present it only as an archival material analogy, not as a lexical replacement for degrees.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The degree noun can activate folding and container branches, while the doubled work root supplies what is preserved and full fulfillment supplies eventual return.

activation_trace.role: Folding and inserting into a cover supplies the material act of preserving deed records.
A drawer or container supplies differentiated compartments for the preserved material.
Intentional deeds supply the contents placed into the archival analogy.
A fixed terminal time supplies the point at which the preserved dossier matures for settlement.
Entering a name in a register supplies the dossier's indexing operation.
A surviving mark supplies durable evidence of what had occurred.

changed_reading.before: Degrees are only points on a vertical scale.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, degrees can be indexed compartments into which deed traces are folded and preserved until complete settlement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because it depends on the packet's non-dominant mapped branch for the protection verb. It remains valid as a split-root resonance with the focus work-wage and full-payment branches. Downstream prose must call it exploratory and preserve ordinary protection as the live primary alternative.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus work root has an explicit wage branch, and full fulfillment excludes deficient payment.

activation_trace.role: The wage and sustenance of a worker supplies the remuneration side of the resonance.
Full payment supplies the rule that remuneration reaches completion without deficiency.
The non-dominant work-recompense and hire branch lets promised protection resonate as protective remuneration.

changed_reading.before: Full return is an abstract result attached to deeds.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, full return can sound like an undiminished hire whose benefit is also shelter from the harmful outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus surface is distributive, not a statement of weariness. It remains anchored through a dormant fatigue branch under the same focus root, activated when later context explicitly denies exhaustion and affirms capability over every thing. Downstream prose should render it as a scale-of-judgment echo, never as a replacement gloss for the distributive word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The distributive focus word carries a fatigue branch in its inventory, and individualized full settlement raises the problem of completeness at total scale.

activation_trace.role: All-enclosing distribution supplies the scale of individualized settlement.
Dullness and exhaustion supply the dormant counter-image activated by the later denial of fatigue.
Completion without deficiency makes unlimited distributive precision the issue at stake.
Bodily weariness supplies the explicitly denied condition that awakens the focus fatigue branch.
Effective capability supplies the positive reason exhaustive settlement is not impaired by scale.
The repeated all-enclosing sense extends capability across the total field rather than a favored subset.

changed_reading.before: For each only marks distributive scope.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified branch echo, the distributive scope also foregrounds inexhaustible adjudicative capacity: each can be settled fully without fatigue degrading precision.

strongest_changes: A static ladder became a set of deed-enacted trajectories, including maturation thresholds and a reception-to-mission process.
A mechanical ledger became a transformed account in which selective acceptance and pardon can precede complete settlement.
The denial of wrong expanded from non-withholding to correct placement and classification after repeated contextual mislabeling.
Deeds expanded from outward events to stewardship of enabled hearing, discernment, and inward motive.
Worldly consumption and later tasting made settlement temporally distributed and experientially realized.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots sustained several mechanisms without forced merger: proportional payment, traversed stages, commissioned work, corrected classification, transformed accounting, capacity stewardship, and processual response. The drawer analogy, the non-dominant protection-to-wage mapping, and the fatigue echo remained live only under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree noun may chiefly denote rank, traversed stage, or differentiated account position; the packet activates all three without disambiguating them.
It is uncertain whether selective acceptance and pardon define the general settlement rule or only the immediately described group's account.
The finite-allocation reading of earlier enjoyment may overconnect two judgment scenes that can also stand independently.
The archival, protective-wage, and fatigue readings should remain analogical or resonant rather than being promoted to ordinary lexical glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Degrees are a stepwise mapping of conduct.** د ر ج B003 is taking step by step and B001 is going along a path; ع م ل B001 is intentional doing. The plural `درجات` is directly generated from what each did. I infer that repeated actions form a traversed gradient rather than merely being sorted into arbitrary ranks. The ayah reads degrees as accumulated path-structure.
2. **Full payment excludes withholding.** و ف ي B001 is complete fullness without shortfall; ظ ل م B008 is prevention and withholding. The purpose clause places full delivery against the negated possibility of withholding. I infer a transactional arrow: every work reaches its corresponding return without being held back. This sharpens `لا يظلمون` into non-deprivation, while leaving broader injustice readings intact.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 46:20 immediately supplies a negative account of the payment mechanism, and 46:34 turns rejected truth into experienced consequence. These later scenes confirm that `يوفيهم` means completed correspondence, not merely undifferentiated reward.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Every intentional path leaves a stepwise profile rather than only a binary label.** `كُلٍّ` activates ك ل ل B003, encompassing totality; `دَرَجَٰتٌ` activates د ر ج B001, movement along a path, and B003, taking something step by step; `عَمِلُوا` activates ع م ل B001, intentional work. The packet first says “for each,” then derives degrees from what they did. I infer that repeated acts accumulate as positions along a course, allowing distinction within the two broad outcomes of the surrounding ayat. The verse therefore adds resolution to judgment: destination and degree both preserve enacted history.

2. **Their works are returned complete, which excludes both shorting and misplacement.** `لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ` activates و ف ي B001, giving an account, wage, right, or measure in full; the repeated `أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ` again activates ع م ل B001. `لَا يُظْلَمُونَ` permits ظ ل م B004, putting something in the wrong place, and B008, withholding a due. The packet strikingly names their works, not merely a detached payment, as what is fulfilled to them. I infer that action ripens into the return assigned to its actor, with neither part removed nor assigned elsewhere. Non-wrongdoing is thus exact correspondence between authored path, degree, and received outcome.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 46:20 immediately staged the promised fulfillment as inspection: ع ر ض B002 brings persons forward while their expended goods and self-elevation are named. The later presentation made 46:19’s “degrees” newly visible as a disclosed history of allocations and postures, not an opaque rank assigned after the fact.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 (46:15-25): Ordered Repair and Accepted Settlement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Received care generates an obligation to repair, after which deeds are assessed, accepted, passed over, and fully settled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Administrative and transactional branches turn piety into an ordered process of repair, review, and non-deficient settlement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Every rank receives a full settlement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Distinct levels are assigned according to work, then each account is completed without withheld value.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Stages or ranks (`quranic:root_000468:B003/m01`); fullness without deficit (`quranic:root_001669:B001/m01`); a worker's wage (`quranic:root_001046:B004/m01`); withholding another's right (`quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `ولكل درجات مما عملوا`, `ليوفيهم أعمالهم`, and `وهم لا يظلمون` (46:19).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Difference in rank does not imply arbitrariness; the branch field frames judgment as exact labor settlement with no missing share.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, keskinlik veya iş görme gücünün azalmasıyla insanın, hayvanın, rüzgarın ve duyuların yorulmasını aynı çekirdekte toplar. Verilen dal bu ortak güçten düşme sınırını doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bütünlük bildiren kullanımları ve mirasla ilgili akrabalık anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın güçten düşme anlamını kapsar; bineği yorma anlamı ise yalnız belirtilen ettirgen söz öbeğine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın, hayvanın, aracın, organın ya da etkin gücün keskinliğini, dayanma gücünü veya iş görme yetisini yitirerek körelmesi ya da yorulmasıdır. Bineği bu duruma düşürme, ayrıca belirli bir ettirgen söz öbeğinde anlatılır.

facets.statement: Keskinliğin, gücün veya iş görme yetisinin azalması temel anlamdır.
Yürüyen insanın ya da hayvanın yorulması ve kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme veya rüzgarın etkisizleşmesi bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir.
Belirli ettirgen söz öbeği, kişinin bineğini yorup güçten düşürmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yorulma ile keskinliğini veya etkinliğini yitirmeyi ortak bir güçten düşme alanında birleştirir; kullanım insan, hayvan, kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme ve rüzgar gibi farklı taşıyıcılara uzanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Keskinlik, dayanma gücü veya etkinlik kaybının birlikte anlatıldığı dal çekirdeğine uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem körelmeyi hem de yorularak güçten düşmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan veya hayvanın yürüme ve çalışma sonucu güçten düştüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlı taşıyıcının yorulma ve güç kaybını eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıç, dil, bakış veya başka bir etkin yetinin keskinliğini yitirdiği bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Keskinlik ve etkinlik kaybını doğal bir Türkçe karşılıkla korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kılıç, dil, duyu ve rüzgar gibi taşıyıcılarda keskinlik veya etkinlik kaybını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yürüme sonucunda insanın veya hayvanın yorulup güçten düşmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal bedensel yorgunlukla sınırlıyken bu dal, aynı güç kaybını araçların keskinliği ile dilin ve duyuların etkinliğine de taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kılıç, dil ve rüzgarın etkisizleşmesi bu dalda açıkça yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gücün tümüyle tükenmesi, bıkkınlık ve eldekinin bitmesi komşu dalın ek kapsamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yorgunluk, bakışın zayıflaması ve gücün kesilmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal körelme ile yorulmayı geniş bir taşıyıcı dizisine uygular; komşu dal ise tükenme, kesilme ve bıkkınlık sonucunu daha belirgin kılar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; yalnız bedensel yorgunluk ve güç tükenmesiyle gerçek anlam örtüşmesi kuran iki komşu yayımlandı, aynı kökün öteki eşsesli dalları ayrım sağlamadığı için alınmadı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, başkasının bakımına ve geçimine yük olan kişiyi çekirdek yapar; yetim, yakın desteği bulunmayan kişi ve bakmakla yükümlü olunan kimse bu alanda sayılır. Dal kullanılabilir, ancak bütün bu kişileri özleri gereği değersizleştiren bir niteleme gibi okunmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki ağırlık fiziksel ağırlık değil, bir başkasının üstlendiği bakım ve geçim yüküdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad bağımlı kişiyi veya yükü bildirir; akrabaların kişiye yük olması gibi okumalar yalnız verilen söz öbeklerine bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bakımı, geçimi veya taşınması başkasının sorumluluğuna yük olan kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem de ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi gibi geleneksel adlandırmalar ile akrabaların birine bağımlı hale gelmesi bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şeyin bakım, geçim veya taşıma bakımından başkasına yük olması çekirdektir.
Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi kanıta bağlı özel referanslardır.
Taşınan tapınma nesnesi ve geçimi bir kişiye kalan akrabalar, bağımlılık ilişkisinin söz öbeğine bağlı örnekleridir.
Kaynak anlatımında ağır tabiatlı kişi ve başkası adına iş gören kişi de bu adlandırmanın çevresinde anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, geçimi veya bakımı bir başkasının üzerinde kalan bağımlı kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi ve hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi öne çıkan özel durumlar, taşınan nesne ile geçimi üstlenilen akrabalar ise ilişkiyi somutlaştıran kullanımlardır. Bir kaynak, ağır tabiatlı kişiyi ve başkası adına iş gören kişiyi de bu adlandırma çevresinde anar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Geçim, bakım veya taşıma sorumluluğunun başka bir kişiye düştüğü çekirdek ilişkiye uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bağımlı olan tarafı ve yükü üstlenen başka tarafı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin geçimini sağlamak zorunda olduğu aile veya yakınlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bakım sorumluluğunu ve bağımlı kişiler topluluğunu açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yetim veya doğrudan aile desteğinden yoksun kişi için açıklayıcı bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin yakın desteğinden yoksun olma özelliğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bakımı üstlenilen kişi veya taşınan şey, yükün kendisi olarak adlandırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal günah, ağır sözleşme ve üstlenilmiş soyut sorumluluğu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişinin üzerinde kalan ve onu ağırlaştıran yük ilişkisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bakım ve geçimde bağımlı olan kişiyi ya da şeyi öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise taşınan somut veya soyut yükün kendisini adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bağımlı kişilerin geçim yükü ve bu yükü taşıyanla ilişkisi anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aile için yapılan harcamanın artırılması ve geçimin genişletilmesi anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aile bireylerinin geçimini sağlama senaryosunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kimin başkasının bakımına bağımlı olduğunu belirtir; komşu dal ise bakımı üstlenen kişinin harcamayı genişletme eylemidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; bakım yüküyle doğrudan sınır paylaşan ve aynı geçim senaryosunu aydınlatan iki komşu seçildi, öteki adaylar farklı eylem ve eşsesli anlamlardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكُلّ بمعنى العيال والثقل، واليتيم، ومن لا ولد له، وما يكون عالة على غيره
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الكُلّ الذي يفيد الإحاطة ولا الكَلالة بوصفها حكما في الورثة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكُلّ العيال واليتيم (maqayis)؛ الكل اليتيم والكل الرجل الذي لا ولد له والكل أيضا الذي هو عيال وثقل (ayn)؛ الكل العيال والثقل والكل اليتيم والكل الذي لا ولد له ولا والد (sihah)؛ الكل الثقيل الروح واليتيم والوكيل والذي هو عيال وثقل على صاحبه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, parçaları veya bireyleri eksiksiz kapsayan ve biçimce tekil olsa da toplu anlam veren belirleyiciyi açıkça tanımlar. Dalın bütünlük ve tamlık çerçevesi bu dilbilgisel çekirdeğe uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir şeyin olgunlaşıp tamamlanma sürecini değil, var olan bütünün eksiksiz kapsamını bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız yalın kapsam belirleyicisini açıklar; belirli kalıplardan yeni bir temel anlam çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir bütünün parçalarını ya da bir kümenin bireylerini eksiksiz biçimde kapsayan, biçimce tekil olsa da toplu anlam verebilen belirleyicidir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin parçalarının veya bir kümedeki bireylerin hiçbirini dışarıda bırakmadan kapsanması çekirdektir.
Sözcük biçimce tekil kullanılırken anlamca bir topluluğun tamamına yönelebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sözcüğün parçaları bir araya getirerek tam kapsam verdiğinde ve tekil biçimle topluluğun bütününü gösterdiğinde birleşir. Bir kaynak, sözcüğü daima tamlanan olarak kullanılan bir kapsam adı şeklinde sınırlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Parçaların veya bireylerin eksiksiz kapsamını bildiren yalın belirleyici için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eksiksiz kapsamı ve bütünlük anlamını doğal Türkçe belirleyicilerle korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir şeyin bütün parçalarının birlikte kastedildiği adlaşmış bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyin hiçbir parçasını dışarıda bırakmayan tam kapsamı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her büyüklükteki kümenin veya bir nesnenin parçalarının tamamını kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kapsamı özellikle iki öğeyle sınırlıdır ve iki ayrı biçimle kurulur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal belirtilen kümedeki öğeleri eksiksiz kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sayı bakımından genel bir bütünlük belirleyicisidir; komşu dal yalnız iki öğenin ikisini birden kapsayan özel belirleyicileri anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Var olan parçaların veya bireylerin eksiksiz olarak kapsama alınmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin gelişip tamamlanması, eksikliğinin giderilmesi veya olgun duruma erişmesi de anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal eksiksizlik ve tam olma düşüncesinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nicel kapsam kuran bir belirleyicidir; komşu dal ise bir şeyin tamam olma durumu ile tamamlanma eylemini de içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi; sayı bakımından özel kapsam ile tamamlanma durumunu ayıran iki komşu yararlı bulundu, deyimsel bütünlük anlatımları çekirdeği ayrıca keskinleştirmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه لفظ الكُلّ لضم الأجزاء وإحاطة الشيء أو الذوات، ومعنى التمام في كل البسط ونحوه

branches.source_phrase_ar: كل اسم موضوع للإحاطة مضاف أبدا (maqayis)؛ كل لفظه واحد ومعناه جمع (sihah)؛ يقع كل على اسم منكور موحد فيؤدي معنى الجماعة وكلهم للإحاطة (tahdhib)؛ لفظ كل هو لضم أجزاء الشيء ويفيد معنى التمام (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki mirasçı yakınları, uzak soy bağını ve doğrudan değil yan koldan geçen mirası birlikte verir. Dal doğru yöndedir; ancak adın ölen kişi, mirasçı topluluğu, akrabalık türü veya miras ilişkisinin kendisi için kullanılabildiği açık tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ana baba ile çocuk bu sınıfın dışındadır; olumsuz söz öbeği ise yan koldan değil doğrudan hakla miras almayı bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yan kol akrabalığı çekirdeğini korur; doğrudan miras ve uzak kuzenlik okumaları kendi söz öbeklerine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki, özellikle uzak veya yan koldaki yakınlar üzerinden kurulan mirasçılık ve akrabalık ilişkisidir. Ad, böyle bir miras bırakan kişi, bu yolla mirasçı olanlar veya ilişkinin kendisi için kullanılabilir.

facets.statement: Doğrudan üstsoy ve altsoy dışında kalan yan kol veya uzak akrabalık temel sınırdır.
Ad, ana babası ve çocuğu bulunmadan ölen kişiye, onun yan kol mirasçılarına veya bu miras biçimine yönelebilir.
Olumsuz miras söz öbeği doğrudan hakla miras almayı, kuzenlik söz öbeği ise uzak akrabalığı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki mirasçı yakınları, uzak kuzenleri ve yan koldan geçen mirası bir araya getirir. Sözcüğün ölen kişiye mi, mirasçılara mı, akrabalığa mı yoksa mirasa mı yöneldiği bağlama göre değişebilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki yakınlar üzerinden kurulan miras ilişkisini açıklamak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dışlanan doğrudan soy çizgisini ve yan kol mirasçılığını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ana baba veya çocuk olmayan uzak bir yakının mirasçı olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Mirasçının doğrudan soy çizgisi dışında bulunmasını açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yakın kuzen olmayan, soy bağı daha uzaktan kurulan kuzen için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kuzenlik bağının doğrudan ve yakın olmayan derecesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki yan kol mirasçılığı
yan koldan değil, doğrudan hakla miras almak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Akrabalığı ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki yan kollara ve miras bağlamına sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Her türlü kan ve soy yakınlığını, doğrudan üstsoy ile altsoyu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal insanlar arasındaki soy bağını ve yakınlık derecesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal miras bağlamında doğrudan üstsoy ve altsoyu dışarıda bırakan özel bir akrabalık sınıfıdır; komşu dal soy yakınlığının tamamını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Mirasçının doğrudan soy çizgisi dışında bulunma koşulunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Malın ölen kişiden herhangi bir yasal veya soy temelli mirasçıya geçmesi olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ölen kişiden kalan malın yakınlara geçmesi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli bir akraba ve mirasçı sınıfını sınırlar; komşu dal ise mirasın kaynaktan mirasçıya geçmesi olayının genel adıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel akrabalık ve genel miras aktarımı en açıklayıcı iki sınırı verdi, öteki adaylar özel miras hükümleri veya yalnız aynı aile alanındaki uzak konulardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكَلالة للميت أو الوارث أو القرابة التي عدا الوالد والولد، وبنو العم الأباعد، والميراث من عرض لا من قرب مباشر
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الولد والوالد، ولا الإرث عن قرب واستحقاق مباشر
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكلالة هم الرجال الورثة وبنو العم الأباعد ومن مات وليس له ولد ولا والد (maqayis)؛ الكل النسب البعيد (ayn)؛ لم يرثه كلالة أي لم يرثه عن عرض والكلالة بنو العم الأباعد (sihah)؛ الكلالة من القرابة ما خلا الوالد والولد (tahdhib)؛ الكلالة اسم لما عدا الولد والوالد من الورثة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir şeyin başı veya çevresi boyunca kuşatıcı biçimde yer alan nesne ve görünümleri ortaklaştırır. Baş çevresindeki süslü kuşak, gök konumu, çevreleyen bulut ve kenarı çiçek ya da küçük bulutlarla sarılı yer bu çekirdeğin destekli uzantılarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, çevreleme biçimini temel alır; dikilmiş koruyucu perde veya genel bütünlük belirleyicisi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın adın çevreleyen nesne anlamları korunur; çiçekle veya bulut parçalarıyla çevrilme yalnız verilen niteleme kalıplarına bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir başın, yerin ya da göksel görünümün çevresini kuşak gibi saran veya kenarlarını belirginleştiren nesne ve oluşumdur. Süslü baş kuşağı, belirli bir gök konumu, çevreleyen bulut ve çiçek ya da küçük bulutlarla çevrilmiş görünüm bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin çevresini kuşak gibi sarma veya kenarını çevreleyerek belirginleştirme çekirdektir.
Süslü baş kuşağı veya taç ile belirli bir gök konumu, yalın adın özel karşılıklarıdır.
Bir yeri dolaşan bulut ya da başka bir örtümsü bulut görünümü çevreleme çekirdeğinin göğe uzanmasıdır.
Çiçeklerle çevrili çayır ve çevresinde küçük bulut parçaları bulunan bulut, belirli niteleme kalıplarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar başı saran süslü kuşağı, belirli gök konumunu ve çevreleme biçimi gösteren bulut ile çayır tasvirlerini aynı çevresini sarma düşüncesinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Baş, yer veya göksel görünüm çevresinde kuşatıcı bir sınır oluşturan dal çekirdeğine uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çevreleme ilişkisini ve kuşak biçimli görünümü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başı çevreleyen süslü kuşak veya değerli taşlarla bezeli başlık bağlamına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başı saran süslü başlık anlamını doğal ve kısa biçimde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ana bulutun çevresinde daha küçük bulut parçalarının bulunduğu görünüm için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Merkezdeki bulutu ve onu çevreleyen parçaları birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Ay'ın konaklarından biri, Akrep takımyıldızının başı
bir yerin çevresini dolaşan örtümsü bulut
çevresi küçük bulut parçalarıyla sarılı bulut

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Süslü baş kuşağı, belirli gök konumu ve bulut çevrelenmesi gibi özel adlandırmaları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Boyun halkası, değirmen parçası ve çeşitli dairesel nesneler gibi daha geniş halka kullanımları vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir şeyin çevresine dolanan halka veya kuşak biçimini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çevreleme biçimini belirli taç ve gök görünümlerinde adlaştırır; komşu dal ise boyun çevresindeki ve başka nesnelerdeki halkayı daha genel ele alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çevreleyen nesne veya görünümün kendisini ve ondan türeyen özel adları belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir topluluğun bir kişi ya da nesnenin çevresini alması eylemini de anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir merkezin çevresinde halka oluşturma düşüncesini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çoğunlukla çevreleyen kuşağın veya göksel görünümün adıdır; komşu dal çevresini alma ve kuşatma eylemini öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün çevreleme adayları gözden geçirildi; halka biçimli nesne ile çevresini alma eylemi en yararlı iki karşılaştırmadır, diğerleri yalnız aynı uzamsal alanda kalan özel nesnelerdir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإكليل، وإطافة الشيء بالرأس أو بالمكان، ومنزل القمر، والسحاب المحيط، والروضة المحفوفة بالنور، والسحاب المكلل بالقطع
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الكَلالة في أحكام الميراث إلا من جهة أصل الإحاطة، ولا يدخل فيه الكِلّة السترية بوصفها بيتا مخيطا
branches.source_phrase_ar: إطافة شيء بشيء والإكليل منزل من منازل القمر والسحاب يدور بالمكان (maqayis)؛ الإكليل شبه عصابة مزينة بالجواهر والإكليل من منازل القمر وروضة مكللة حفت بالنور (ayn)؛ الإكليل شبه عصابة ويسمى التاج إكليلا والإكليل منزل والسحاب كأن غشاء ألبسه وروضة مكللة وسحاب مكلل (sihah)؛ الغمام المكلل السحابة تكون حولها قطع والإكليل شبه عصابة والإكليل منزل (tahdhib)؛ الإكليل سمي بذلك لإطافته بالرأس (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, ince kumaştan dikilip küçük bir ev gibi kurulan böcek koruyucu örtüyü açıkça verir; mezarlar üzerine küçük yapı, kubbe veya kule yükseltme kullanımı da aynı biçim benzerliğiyle eklenir. Bu ikinci kullanım temel nesnenin kendisiyle özdeşleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek dikilmiş koruyucu örtüdür; mezar yapısı, yalnız ona benzeyen yükseltilmiş yapı kalıbındaki uzantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad dikilmiş ince örtüyü bildirir; mezar üstüne yapı yükseltme anlamı yalnız belirtilen söz öbeğinde geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Sivrisinek veya tahtakurusu gibi böceklerden korunmak için ince kumaştan dikilip küçük bir ev gibi kurulan örtüdür. Mezar üzerine buna benzeyen küçük kule veya kubbe biçimli yapı yükseltmek, söz öbeğine bağlı bir uzantıdır.

facets.statement: İnce kumaştan dikilen ve küçük bir ev gibi kurulabilen koruyucu örtü temel nesnedir.
Örtünün sivrisinek ve tahtakurusu gibi böceklere karşı korunma amacı vardır.
Mezarın üzerine küçük kule veya kubbe benzeri yapı yükseltmek, biçim benzerliğine dayalı söz öbeği uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak nesnesi, böceklerden korunmak için ince kumaştan dikilen ev biçimli örtüdür. Mezar üzerinde küçük yapı veya kubbe yükseltme, bu biçimden hareket eden özel bir yapı kullanımını oluşturur.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnce kumaştan dikilen ve böceklerden korunmak için kurulan temel nesneye uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Örtünün biçimini, malzeme niteliğini ve koruma işlevini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Uyuyan kişiyi sivrisinek ve benzeri böceklerden koruyan kumaş örtü bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Böceklerden koruyan yatak çevresi örtüsünü doğal Türkçe adıyla korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mezar üzerinde küçük kule veya kubbe benzeri yapı yükseltme söz öbeği için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yapının mezar üzerinde yükseltilmesini ve kubbemsi biçimini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: böceklerden koruyan ev biçimli ince örtü, cibinlik
mezar üzerine küçük kule veya kubbe biçimli yapı yükseltmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnce kumaştan dikilip ev gibi kurulur ve özellikle böceklere karşı korur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Her türlü örtme, gizlenme ve örtü nesnesini biçim veya amaç sınırlaması olmadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir şeyi kumaş veya benzeri engelle örterek koruma alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal biçimi dikilmiş küçük eve benzeyen ve böceklere karşı kullanılan özel örtüdür; komşu dal örtme ve gizlenmenin genel alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişinin çevresine kurulan bütün bir koruyucu örtü düzenini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çadırın yalnız arka bölümünü oluşturan dikilmiş bir veya iki kumaş parçasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal dikilmiş kumaş parçalarının küçük ev veya çadır düzeninde kullanılmasını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal böceklere karşı çevreleyen bağımsız koruyucu örtüdür; komşu dal çadırın belirli bir bölümünü kapatan yapı parçasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün örtü ve yapı adayları incelendi; genel örtme ile çadırın dikilmiş özel parçası sınırı açıklar, diğer adaylar işlev veya yapı bakımından daha uzaktır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكِلّة غشاء أو ستر رقيق يخاط كالبيت للوقاية من البعوض والبق، وما يشبه الصوامع والقباب في تكليل القبور
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الإكليل الذي يحيط بالرأس، ولا الكُلّ بمعنى الجميع
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكلة غشاء من ثوب يتوقى به من البعوض (ayn)؛ الكلة الستر الرقيق يخاط كالبيت يتوقى فيه من البق (sihah)؛ الكلة من الستور ما خيط فصار كالبيت والتكليل رفعها ببناء مثل الكلل وهي الصوامع والقباب (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynaklar iki ses biçimini de göğüs karşılığı olarak doğrudan ve tutarlı biçimde verir. Dalın beden bölgesi kimliği ek bir işlem, nitelik veya mecaz gerektirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnız göğüs bölgesini adlandırır; kısa ve kalın erkek nitelemesiyle topluluk anlamındaki çoğul biçim ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın beden bölgesi adını verir ve niteleme ya da söz öbeği anlamı eklemez.

concept_map.definition: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninin boyun ile karın arasında kalan ön üst bölümü, yani göğüstür.

facets.statement: Bedenin ön üst bölümündeki göğüs bölgesinin adı olması tek ve doğrudan çekirdektir.
Aynı beden bölgesi iki yakın ses biçimiyle adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bütün kaynak anlatımları sözcüğü doğrudan göğüs bölgesinin adı olarak verir; bir kaynak yakın sesli ikinci biçimi de aynı anlamla kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninin boyun altındaki ön üst bölgesini adlandıran bütün kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Beden bölgesi kimliğini kısa ve doğrudan biçimde eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Beden bölümünün konumunu açıkça belirtmenin gerektiği açıklayıcı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Anatomik bölgenin göğüs olduğunu açık ve eksiksiz biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalnız göğüs bölgesinin yalın adı olarak sınırlandırılmıştır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Göğsün üst çıkıntısı, rahatsızlıkları, örtüleri, işaretleri ve güce dayalı adlandırmaları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal insan veya hayvan bedeninin göğüs bölgesini doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yalnız beden bölgesi adıdır; komşu dal aynı bölgeyi merkez alarak hastalık, örtü, işaret ve niteleme gibi ilişkili kullanımlara da açılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Göğsün tüm bölgesini genel bir beden bölümü olarak belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Göğüs ile karın sınırında öne çıkan belirli bir kemiği anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal göğüs anatomisi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal geniş beden bölgesinin adıdır; komşu dal o bölgede yer alan belirli bir kemik yapısını adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; genel göğüs dalı ile belirli göğüs kemiği, bütün-parça sınırını en iyi gösterdi, diğer anatomik adaylar daha uzak bölümlerdir.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الرجل الكُلْكُل القصير الغليظ ولا الكلاكل الجماعات

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, erkek için kısa boy, kalınlık, güç ve toplu beden yapısını birlikte verir. Dal bu nitelikleri tek bir yapı betimlemesi olarak doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnız erkek niteleyen söz öbeğinde geçerlidir; göğüs adı veya topluluk adı olarak genelleştirilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım açıkça erkek niteleyen söz öbeğine bağlıdır ve sözcüğe bağımsız bir temel anlam yüklemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir erkeği çok uzun olmayan, kısa ya da orta boylu; kalın, güçlü ve bedeni toplu yapılı olarak niteleyen söz öbeğidir.

facets.statement: Erkeğin kısa veya çok uzun olmayan boyu ile kalın ve güçlü beden yapısı birlikte belirtilir.
Bedenin dağınık değil toplu, sıkı ve derli toplu görünmesi nitelemenin tamamlayıcı yönüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar erkek nitelemesinde kısa ya da çok uzun olmayan boyu, kalınlığı, gücü ve toplu beden yapısını bir arada verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalnız erkek bedeninin kısa, kalın ve toplu yapısını niteleyen kalıptır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün yapı nitelemeleri değerlendirildi; kısa ve toplu beden ile geniş taşıyıcılı kalınlık dalları gerçek sınırları gösterdi, yalnız iri veya ağır olmayı anlatanlar daha uzaktır.
